_note: Parity fixture for capability_reason, which exists twice on purpose: in probe/probe.py and in functions/bundle/run. A function cannot import from the instrument, so the copies are checked against these fixed answers by scripts/verify-parity.py rather than deduplicated.
_why_shapes: Each address is stored as a shape with an {id} placeholder, assembled by the check rather than written out. verify-privacy.py rejected the first version of this file, which spelled the URLs in full, and it was right to: a fabricated capability URL is indistinguishable from a real one to a reader and to a scanner, and the next person to extend this file would have had a literal to copy. Storing the shape says what is being tested without ever putting a capability-shaped string in the tree.
_heuristic: Flagging is a heuristic over known shapes. Absence of a flag is not a clearance: the negatives below assert only that the current list does not fire, never that the address is safe to hand to someone.

cases.why: the account segment u/0 sits between the type and the id; a pattern without it misses the real shape, which is the bug this list shipped with once
share shortlink, distinct from a comments URL
a token long enough to be a secret
below the length floor; a short token is more likely page state than a secret
an ordinary comments URL, which is an address and not a capability
the bare host names no document
a per-share wrapper. Unique to the share, but not unlisted-by-URL access: this is the join problem, not the disclosure problem
paywalled is not unlisted; the address discloses nothing
